class.name: FileSystemDatabase
class.brief_description: A [NetwDatabaseBackend] that keeps records in files under one directory.
class.description: Records stay on disk after the game closes. Use it for a singleplayer or listen server game. [codeblock] var backend := FileSystemDatabase.new() backend.root = "user://saves" backend.format = FileSystemDatabase.FORMAT_TEXT Netw.configure_database(self, &"saves").backend(backend) [/codeblock] Each slot is a directory under [member root], and each record is one file inside it. A record reads back in either [enum Format], so changing [member format] keeps every save, and the next write of a record replaces its file with one in the new format. [b]Record files[/b] A [code].dict[/code] or [code].tdict[/code] file loads with [method ResourceLoader.load] as a [DictionaryRecord]. Its [member DictionaryRecord.data] holds the stored record, with the saved columns under [code]payload[/code]. Saving that record with [method ResourceSaver.save] writes the file the database reads, so a save can be inspected and edited in the editor. Edit a save while the game is closed, since the next save of that record replaces the file. [codeblock] var record: DictionaryRecord = load("user://saves/campaign/0/players/hero.tdict") record.data[&"payload"][&"gold"] = 100 ResourceSaver.save(record, record.resource_path) [/codeblock] A record file never builds an object or loads a resource. A file this library did not write, or a [code].tdict[/code] naming an [code]Object[/code] or a [code]Resource[/code], fails to read with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED].

members.member: The format a record is written in.
The directory every slot lives under. Use a path under [code]user://[/code], which an exported game can write to on every platform.

constants.constant: Writes each record as a compact [code].dict[/code] file.
Writes each record as a [code].tdict[/code] file in the text form of [method @GlobalScope.var_to_str], which a person can read and edit.
